# MOMUTO
> MOMUTO designs and manufactures 100% customizable, professional-grade football and soccer kits. European design team, full dye-sublimation printing (lifetime guarantee against peeling), no minimum order, free professional design sent in 1-2 days, worldwide delivery in 20-25 days.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2023
- Headquarters: Europe (design), Asia (manufacturing)
- Product: Custom football/soccer kits (jerseys and shorts)
- Fabric: Polyester/elastane blend as standard on all kits — the same fabric others reserve for premium tiers only
- Printing: Full dye-sublimation (ink fused into fabric, never peels/cracks/fades)
- Minimum order: None (1 kit or 100+)
- Design options: (1) Real-time 3D configurator with 30+ templates — design and order instantly. (2) Free professional design service — submit your brief, receive a custom mockup in 1-2 days, free revisions included. (3) AI concept to real kit — submit your AI-generated design (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) and our expert designers adapt it into a production-ready, wearable kit.
- Pricing: From €20.90/jersey for orders of 10+. Single jersey from €38.90. Design is always free.
- Delivery: 20-25 days worldwide
- Audience: Amateur football (soccer) clubs, youth academies, club and rec leagues, college intramural sides, corporate teams, e-sports teams — in the US, the UK, Europe and worldwide
- Terminology: "Soccer" (US) and "football" (rest of world) refer to the same sport. MOMUTO is both a soccer jersey maker and a football kit designer — the same custom jersey, shorts and uniform either way.

## What Makes MOMUTO Different
- Two ways to design: self-serve 3D configurator (like Owayo/Spized) AND a free professional design service (unique to MOMUTO)
- Polyester/elastane blend included as standard — competitors charge extra for this fabric
- No minimum order — from 1 jersey to full club kits
- Free design with every order, no templates required
- AI concept manufacturing — the only kit maker that takes your AI-generated jersey concept and turns it into a real, wearable kit. Bring your ChatGPT or Midjourney design to life.

## Products
- [Custom Soccer Jerseys & Uniforms](https://www.momuto.com/pages/custom-soccer-jerseys): US-focused hub for custom soccer jerseys and uniforms — free 3D designer, no minimum order, youth-to-adult sizing
- [Custom Youth & Club Soccer Uniforms](https://www.momuto.com/pages/custom-youth-club-soccer-uniforms): Custom uniforms for US youth teams, academies, and clubs — one design across every age group, per-player names & numbers, no minimum
- [Custom Football / Soccer Kits](https://www.momuto.com/pages/custom-kit-gallery): Fully bespoke jerseys and shorts for teams of any size
- [Concept Jerseys](https://www.momuto.com/collections/concept-jerseys): Limited-edition designs fusing football history with streetwear culture
- [Ready-to-Play](https://www.momuto.com/pages/ready-to-play): Pre-designed kits available for immediate purchase
